encoding.ballots: 349 characters, character b-1 = ballot of bench b: J=Ja, N=Nej, A=Avstår, F=Frånvarande
encoding.dok_id: riksdag document id of the betänkande (or chamber vote); the document is at https://data.riksdagen.se/dokument/<dok_id>
encoding.punkt_title: heading (rubrik) of the förslagspunkt voted on; null for chamber votes or if none found
encoding.rosters: 349 seat_holders indices, element b-1 = occupant of bench b (member or substitute)
encoding.title: title of the document voted on (betänkande title; for a chamber vote with a numeric beteckning, its subject) from data.riksdagen.se/utskottsforslag/<dok_id>.json; null if none found

excluded_votes.reason: in the bulk archive but absent from the voteringlista register (withdrawn or re-run vote)

title_sources.listing: one line per file, sorted by name: '<file> <sha256>\n'; every file is in manifest.json
